release_notes: Templates and reporting, done properly - and every number on the screen now earned. 196 traffic-source and 395 affiliate-network templates generated from Keitaro's own exports ship built-in (209 sources and 438 networks in the dropdowns, nothing to import by hand), replacing a hand-written batch whose macros were invented and quietly tracked nothing. Keitaro status transforms and the {clickid}/{offer_id}/{conversion_revenue} postback macros resolve. Reports gain a customizer: searchable column picker with presets, up to five group-by levels with URL-param dimensions, eq/neq/contains filters, drag-and-drop header reordering, horizontal scroll with a pinned name column, and a flat single-level default - the multi-level drill-down is one '+' away. The full 64-metric Keitaro set is computed in one shared place and verified end-to-end against a hand-computed reference: conversions count events (CR may exceed 100% again), purchases count conversions, deposits no longer double as sales, registrations/deposits and revenue-by-status actually populate, ROI at zero spend is a dash, and Bots, Bot %, Proxies, Visitors, unique clicks by campaign/flow/global, Empty referrers and Time since LP click are recorded per click (migration 20) instead of rendering plausible zeros. The date-range picker's timezone genuinely shifts every date condition server-side. Redirect streams accept a direct external URL with {subid}/{clickid}/{ip}/{country} substituted. Cloaking UI refined to per-layer toggles; the landing editor gains every redirect method; Cost Sync adds an in-campaign connection modal and manual spend; bot-list import is transactional and chunked (50k+ rows). Migration 19 indexes the report joins; the update check says 'check failed' with the manual git pull instead of a fake 'no update' when GitHub is unreachable; the affiliate network editor follows all five themes again. i18n parity across 7 locales; new permanent test suites for templates and metric math.
